citations.assessment: Mari bar Isak is approached by a man from Bei Chozai claiming to be his brother. The root’s opening reading and the later correction intentionally use the same ambiguous word.
The parallel explicitly gives Mari or Chana, both bar Isak in this witness, and the same brother claim. Heilprin’s opening Issi form remains distinct.
The other source explicitly names Rav Acha of Bei Chozai as the speaker, in the homily on the town names. The chronology is Heilprin’s inference from the surrounding discussion.
